title: Firecrawl
description: Connection to a self-hosted Firecrawl instance (REST API v2) for scraping, mapping and crawling web pages.

firecrawl.description: Identifier flag of the firecrawl connection type

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the Firecrawl instance; the client appends /v2/...

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: API key of the instance; stored encrypted and returned masked as "********" (send the mask or omit the key to keep the stored value). The 'Authorization: Bearer' header is only sent when it is set

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: HTTP timeout per request; defaults to 30 seconds. Capped at 55 seconds so that synchronous scrape and map requests end before a PHP request timeout of 60 seconds

verify_ssl.title: Verify TLS certificate
verify_ssl.description: Verify the TLS certificate and host name of the instance; defaults to true
